verdict.rationale: Stagehand's first-party docs say extract() pulls structured data from a page using an instruction plus an output shape. The result is validated against that shape before being returned, so callers get typed data rather than raw text. Python support is mentioned, but Zod or Pydantic schemas are not named explicitly. missing for 10: explicit naming of Zod/Pydantic schema support, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction validation, detail on validation failure handling.
